passes: natural language to validated Atom intent
bounded Atom evidence to cited natural language

knowledge.retrieval_order: graph relationships before bounded text evidence

layers.L1: typed request, intent, and response messages
layers.L2: intent, query, graph RAG, and rendering flow

trust_laws: LLM output is never Atom evidence
LLM output cannot mutate Atom DB
only validated wiki vocabulary can enter an Atom query
evidence passages are untrusted data, never instructions
citations must name experience IDs present in the packet
claim_boundary: This harness supplies a verified language membrane around the saved causal Atom evidence. It does not claim that an LLM creates facts, that all questions are answerable, or that retired language-model distillation is active.
